title: Meet up update / octopus.
content: I’m not sure if it was just my sub conscious mind that created this since I was looking at the meet up posts and code word before I fell asleep, but last night in my dream (pretty sure I was at the grocery store ) the locations from last night are kinda blurry / hard to remember, but there was a guy, skinny , tall , short medium light brown hair, he looked out of place and confused, I said “octopus “ and the guy replied “I always love meeting my 8 legged friends!” I was then pushed out of the dream and I woke up around 4:00 am . Also after posting about many experiences in mall world I have noticed my dreams are harder to remember, I used to remember almost all of my dreams and be able to think about the situations or places for days, but now I am finding things harder and harder to remember like it’s been erased from my mind…… The past few nights I’ve been in mall world when I wake up i have the memories but within a few minutes it’s like the memories from the dream are being sucked from my mind…… but I can still feel them there I just can’t put much detail like I used to idk how to explain it…
